content: तन्त्रिन् {%a.%} .²1 Having threads, made of threads. .²2 Having chords or wires (as a lute). .²3 Having a Tantra, or following one. --{%m.%} .²1 A musician. .²2 A soldier. --{%n.%} An act having a group of subsidiaries common with some other act, a main act (प्रधानकर्म); तन्त्रीणि प्रधानानि . <ls>ŚB. on MS. 12. 1. 1</ls>.
